# CAA Checker

> Free, single-page tool to inspect and generate DNS CAA (Certification Authority Authorization) records.

Static site (no backend, no build step, no dependencies) at https://caa.hbenali.ovh — a single `index.html` calling public APIs directly from the browser. Looks up a domain's CAA records via DNS-over-HTTPS, and includes a generator for `issue`/`issuewild`/`iodef` records with CA autocomplete and BIND zone-file export.

## Pages
- [CAA Checker](https://caa.hbenali.ovh/): the tool itself.
